issue_context.title: Animation for expanding video description is broken
issue_context.body:
### Version
- 0.19.8

### Steps to reproduce the bug
1. Go to a video
2. Tap on video title

### Expected behavior
The animation when touching video title to expand the description is smooth and doesn't feel janky.

### Actual behavior
The animation when tapping the video title seems cut short/laggy. It causes a circle to appear instantly around where you tapped and it then goes away too fast.

review_comments: I think you can safely assume that `binding.detailVideoTitleView` will always be instance of `NewPipeTextView`. Also, I wonder why the binding element is not already cast to that type. Maybe check if the text view has type `NewPipeTextView` both in the normal and the large-land layouts

I think you can safely assume that `binding.detailVideoTitleView` will always be instance of `NewPipeTextView`. Also, I wonder why the binding element is not already cast to that type. Maybe check if the text view has type `NewPipeTextView` both in the normal and the large-land layouts
